subject: Mathematics
title: Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations
summary: i ek naya number hai jiska square −1 hai. Har complex number z = a + ib ek point (a, b) hai Argand plane mein — real part x-axis, imaginary part y-axis.
Do tareeke se dekho: cartesian (a + ib) jodne-ghatane ke liye aur polar (r, θ) guna-bhaag ke liye — polar mein multiply karna = modulus guna, argument jodo.
Quadratic ax² + bx + c = 0 ki poori kahani discriminant D = b² − 4ac aur roots ke relation (α + β = −b/a, αβ = c/a) mein hai.
JEE mein sabse zyada: i ki powers, modulus-argument, conjugate ke properties, aur roots ke symmetric expressions (α² + β², 1/α + 1/β …).

formulas.name: Powers of i
formulas.formula: i¹ = i, i² = −1, i³ = −i, i⁴ = 1 (har 4 par repeat)
formulas.when: iⁿ: n ko 4 se divide karo, remainder dekho.

formulas.name: Modulus and conjugate
formulas.formula: |z| = √(a² + b²),   z̄ = a − ib,   z · z̄ = |z|²

formulas.name: Polar form
formulas.formula: z = r (cosθ + i sinθ) = r e^{iθ},   arg(z₁z₂) = arg z₁ + arg z₂
formulas.mistake: Principal argument (−π, π] mein hota hai; quadrant dekh kar θ lo.

formulas.name: Quadratic formula
formulas.mistake: Real coefficients mein D < 0 ⇒ roots conjugate pair.

formulas.name: Equation from roots
formulas.when: Diye gaye roots se equation banana.

examples.title: Symmetric expression
examples.problem: α, β roots hain x² − 3x + 1 = 0 ke. α² + β²?

examples.title: Equal roots
examples.problem: x² + kx + 9 = 0 ke roots barabar hon to k?

topics.title: Argand plane
topics.explain: z = a + ib point (a, b) hai. |z| origin se doori, arg z positive x-axis se angle. |z − z₁| = r ek circle hai jiska centre z₁ hai.

topics.title: Conjugate ke properties
topics.explain: (z₁ + z₂)‾ = z̄₁ + z̄₂, (z₁z₂)‾ = z̄₁ z̄₂, z real ⇔ z = z̄, z purely imaginary ⇔ z + z̄ = 0.

topics.title: Nature of roots
topics.explain: D > 0: do alag real roots; D = 0: equal real roots; D < 0: non-real conjugate roots. Agar a, b, c rational aur D perfect square, to roots rational.

topics.title: Common root
topics.explain: Do quadratics a₁x² + b₁x + c₁ = 0 aur a₂x² + b₂x + c₂ = 0 ka ek common root ho to (c₁a₂ − c₂a₁)² = (b₁c₂ − b₂c₁)(a₁b₂ − a₂b₁).

topics.title: Sign of a quadratic
topics.explain: a > 0 aur D < 0 ⇒ ax² + bx + c har real x ke liye positive. Graph upward parabola jo x-axis ko chhoota hi nahi.
